stories.title: ALDS Game 5 Tonight — Guardians vs. White Sox, Winner-Take-All at Progressive Field
stories.angle: Winner meets Tampa Bay Rays in ALCS starting Oct. 12. The White Sox — who haven't reached the ALCS since their 2005 World Series run — are one game from ending a 21-year drought. The Guardians have the crowd, the momentum, and José Ramírez.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
TONIGHT: Guardians vs. White Sox. Winner-take-all. Game 5.

Progressive Field. 8 PM ET. TBS.

The White Sox haven't been to the ALCS since 2005. Cleveland wants to stop that. #ForTheLand #WhiteSox

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Gavin Williams vs. Sean Burke. Progressive Field. 8 PM ET.

One game. One ticket to the ALCS.

The Guardians erased a 0-2 series deficit to get here. Can Cleveland finish it tonight? #ForTheLand

stories.title: Rays' Historic ALDS Sweep — Mesa Jr. Homer, Fan Interference Drama
stories.angle: The Yankees hadn't been swept in a best-of-five postseason since the 1980 ALCS. The Rays' third ALCS in franchise history begins Oct. 12.

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Victor Mesa Jr. hit a 2-run homer off Max Fried. Fan interference gave the Yankees false hope. The review upheld it.

Tampa Bay swept New York 3-0. The Yankees hadn't been swept in a best-of-5 postseason since 1980.

The Rays are going to the ALCS. #RaysUp

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
The Rays gave up 5 total runs in their 3-game ALDS sweep of the Yankees.

FIVE runs. In a sweep.

Tampa Bay's third ALCS in franchise history starts Monday. #RaysUp

article.headline: Rays Sweep Yankees in ALDS: Mesa Jr. Homer, Fan Interference Drama, and Tampa Bay's Third ALCS

stories.title: NLCS Preview — Dodgers vs. Brewers, Game 1 Tomorrow Night
stories.angle: Blake Snell is back and in the rotation. Jacob Misiorowski (11-5, 1.76 ERA) is the Brewers' ace. Shohei Ohtani's pitching status is unresolved.

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Blake Snell is healthy. Yoshinobu Yamamoto is ready.

Milwaukee's Jacob Misiorowski went 11-5 with a 1.76 ERA this year.

Dodgers-Brewers NLCS starts TOMORROW at 8 PM ET on FOX. Game 1 in Milwaukee. #Dodgers #Brewers

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
The Dodgers are going for a 3-peat World Series.

The Brewers are in their first NLCS since 2025.

One of them gets the pennant. Game 1 is tomorrow in Milwaukee. #Dodgers #BrewCrew

stories.title: Altuve Falls One Homer Short of All-Time Postseason HR Record
stories.angle: Altuve already owns records for most career postseason HRs by an infielder and most first-inning postseason HRs (8). One more next year would make history.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
José Altuve finished the 2026 postseason with 28 career postseason home runs.

Manny Ramírez's all-time record: 29.

The Astros are done. The chase continues in 2027. #Astros
